title: narcissus linnaeanus subsp. intermedius
intro: Narcissus linnaeanus subsp. intermedius, commonly known as the intermediate daffodil or Lent lily, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as pain, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus linnaeanus subsp. intermedius include its ability to act as a stimulant, expectorant, and antispasmodic, making it a potential treatment for conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
